summary_en: Dividend per share for fiscal year ending March 2027 raised from 93 yen to 97 yen, reflecting reduced share count due to buyback activity and targeting a payout ratio of 80% or higher.
title_en: Notice Regarding Revision of Dividend Forecast (Dividend Increase)
translation_en_brief:
On November 6, 2026, Techno Medica announced a revision of its dividend forecast for the fiscal year ending March 31, 2027. The final dividend per share was increased from the previously forecast 93 yen to 97 yen, representing a 4-yen increase.

The company attributes this upward revision to a reduction in the number of shares eligible for dividend distribution resulting from share buyback activity. The company has emphasized that shareholder returns through dividends represent a key strategic initiative over the medium-term plan period spanning fiscal 2027 through fiscal 2029. Under this framework, the company targets a payout ratio of 80% or higher and determines dividend levels each period by comprehensively considering the operating environment and other factors.

Given the reduced share count from the buyback program, management recalculated the dividend forecast in accordance with this established dividend policy, leading to the upward revision announced in this disclosure. The prior fiscal year (ending March 31, 2026) recorded an actual dividend of 129 yen per share.
